description:
Write a new public review of a fragrance, or edit your existing one. Reviews are published on Noteboxd under the user's name, so this is a two-step action: first call with `confirmed: false` (the default) to get a preview, show the user the exact text and scores, and only after they explicitly approve call again with the same arguments and `confirmed: true`. Never set `confirmed: true` on the first call. Review text must be 50 to 5000 characters. A new review needs `score`; when editing, omitted fields keep their current values. Free for any signed-in account.

See also: `user_rate_fragrance` for a score without text · `user_review_delete` · `user_get_reviews`.

body.description: The review text, written or approved by the user (50-5000 characters)

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user has seen the preview and approved publishing

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

score.description: Overall score 1-10. Required for a new review

name: user_review_upsert
